datasetDetails: en: Version and year: 2020 and the linked paper refer to the original TartanAir publication, not a verified V2 release year. This record documents the current V2 dataset/toolkit; its separate release date was not established.; Raw cameras and baseline: Two simulated optical centres, 0.25 m apart; six 90° pinhole directions per centre cover a sphere. Each raw view is 640×640 at 10 Hz (f=320, principal point=(320,320)); the six directions do not create six stereo baselines.; Panorama and fisheye: Official download/API names include lcam/rcam_fish and lcam/rcam_equirect for RGB, depth and semantics. These are resampled pinhole data, not independently captured fisheye/ERP sensors. Inspect actual availability for the chosen environment and trajectory.; Custom camera models: ta.customize() supports pinhole, DoubleSphere, LinearSphere and Equirectangular at the reviewed tartanairpy commit 158a684; save raw_side, R_raw_new and model parameters. A custom 195° DoubleSphere example is not the default downloaded fisheye specification.; Depth format and meaning: Decode four-channel PNG bytes as little-endian float32 without integer scaling. Raw pinhole depth is Z; reviewed reader.read_dist() converts it to ray distance before ta.customize() resampling. That custom output is range, including custom pinhole output; do not apply the raw-Z conversion twice to ERP/fisheye files. Pin precomputed archives to their own generation convention.; Valid depth: Exclude invalid/nonpositive or nonfinite values, invalid camera rays and far-sky returns; the official modality documentation warns that sky depths can be very large. Publish the task-specific maximum range and mask instead of assuming a universal valid cutoff.; Poses and calibration: Pose rows are tx ty tz qx qy qz qw, describing camera-to-world position/orientation with NED conventions (forward, right, down). Keep metric translation, per-view rotations and stereo extrinsics. Customizer rotates quaternion orientation when R_raw_new changes; transformed views are not new physical trajectories.; Timing and derived sensors: Raw RGB/depth are aligned and synchronized. IMU is synthesized by differentiating interpolated poses, with configurable rate/noise; LiDAR is sampled from depth. Events use separately recollected 1000 Hz RGB and may differ in dynamic scenes. These are simulated signals, not measured sensor ground truth.; Flow and access: Use pip install tartanair and ta.download() to select environments, easy/hard trajectories, cameras and modalities. Current documentation moves flow labels to local generation; do not infer every modality is precomputed from an older all-modality example.; Evaluation and split: Report the exact environments, trajectories, camera sampler and depth masks. Keep all resampled views of one trajectory in the same split; easy/hard folders alone are not an independent scene split. For ATE/RPE, state alignment and whether scale correction was enabled; synthetic accuracy does not establish real-camera robustness.; zh: 版本与年份: 2020 与论文链接对应原始 TartanAir 论文，不能视为已核实的 V2 发布年份。本条整理当前 V2 数据与工具，尚未确证其单独发布日期。; 原始相机与基线: 两个相距 0.25 m 的仿真光心，每个光心有六个朝向的 90° 透视图以覆盖球面。原图为 640×640、10 Hz，焦距 320、主点 (320,320)；六个朝向不是六组独立双目基线。; 全景与鱼眼: 官方下载/API 为 RGB、深度和语义列出 lcam/rcam_fish 与 lcam/rcam_equirect。它们由透视数据重采样，不是独立采集的鱼眼／ERP 传感器；应按目标环境和轨迹核对实际可用项。; 自定义相机模型: 核验的 tartanairpy 提交 158a684 中，ta.customize() 支持 pinhole、DoubleSphere、LinearSphere 与 Equirectangular；需保存 raw_side、R_raw_new 和模型参数。示例的 195° DoubleSphere 不能当作默认下载鱼眼的规格。; 深度格式与语义: 四通道 PNG 的字节应按小端 float32 解码，不作整数缩放。原始透视深度为 Z；核验的 reader.read_dist() 先转为射线距离，再由 ta.customize() 重采样。因此该入口的自定义输出为 range，连自定义透视输出也如此；ERP／鱼眼文件不能重复做原始 Z 转换。预计算压缩包仍须核对其生成约定。; 深度有效性: 排除非正数、非有限值、模型无效射线与远处天空；官方说明天空可能返回极大深度。应记录任务使用的距离上限和掩码，不假设统一有效阈值。; 位姿与标定: 位姿每行为 tx ty tz qx qy qz qw，表示相机到世界的位置／朝向，采用 NED 约定（前、右、下）。保留米制平移、逐视图旋转与双目外参。改变 R_raw_new 后 customizer 会同步旋转四元数；重采样视图不是新增物理轨迹。; 时序与派生传感器: 原始 RGB／深度对齐且同步。IMU 对插值位姿求导合成，频率和噪声可配；LiDAR 由深度采样。事件以另行重采的 1000 Hz RGB 生成，在动态场景可能与其他模态不一致。这些均为仿真信号，不能表述成实测传感器真值。; 光流与获取: 通过 pip install tartanair 与 ta.download() 选择环境、easy/hard 轨迹、相机和模态。当前文档将光流转为本地生成，不能从旧的全模态示例推断都可直接下载。; 评测与划分: 注明具体环境、轨迹、相机采样器与深度掩码；同一轨迹的重采样视图必须归入同一划分，easy/hard 目录本身不是独立场景划分。ATE/RPE 需注明对齐与是否校正尺度；仿真精度不等于对真实相机的鲁棒性。

datasetDetails: en: Projection and inputs: 1024×768 RGB crops, 60° horizontal ×45° vertical FOV, extracted from scanner panoramas. Full scanner capture does not imply a public ERP benchmark.; Depth and validity: NumPy depth and binary validity arrays; mask 1 means valid return. Paper derives samples along scanner rays; range/Z should be checked before reprojection.; Measurement and timing: FARO laser measurements provide depth; RGB is collected after the scan, so moving objects can disagree despite manual curation.; Calibration and annotations: Official devkit supplies camera intrinsics and normal/metric utilities. Normals are derived from neighboring 3D samples.; Evaluation: Public train/validation depth and normals are documented; do not treat validation as unseen test after tuning. Keep crops from the same scan together.; zh: 投影与输入: 从扫描器全景提取 1024×768 RGB 裁剪图，水平 60°、垂直 45°；扫描过程为全景不代表公开版本是 ERP 基准。; 深度与有效性: NumPy 深度与二值有效掩码，1 表示有效回波。论文沿扫描射线生成样本，重投影前仍需核对径向距离与 Z 约定。; 测量与时间: FARO 激光测量提供深度；RGB 在扫描后采集，尽管经过人工筛选，动态物体仍可能造成不一致。; 标定与标注: 官方工具提供相机内参、法向及评测工具，法向由邻域三维采样估计。; 评测协议: 官方明确发布训练、验证深度和法向；调参后不能把验证集称为未见测试集，同一扫描的裁剪图应保持同组。

datasetDetails: en: Projection and inputs: Official release centers on textured meshes and a renderer, not one fixed RGB-D sequence. Perspective frame resolution/intrinsics depend on the chosen renderer.; Depth and validity: Depth is rendered from reconstructed geometry. Serialization scale, range/Z and invalid pixels must be checked for the specific trajectory export.; Ground truth: Dense meshes, semantic/instance and plane annotations; glass/mirror metadata. Rendered poses are simulator references, not physical tracking measurements.; Calibration and timing: Trajectory and camera calibration are renderer inputs. No physical IMU synchronization guarantee follows from the asset release.; Evaluation: Name the exact sequence producer, scene list, coordinate convention and depth scale. Avoid training on the same underlying room through another derivative.; zh: 投影与输入: 官方以纹理网格和渲染器为主，不是固定的一套 RGB-D 序列；透视帧分辨率、内参由渲染配置决定。; 深度与有效性: 深度来自重建几何渲染。序列导出的数值缩放、径向距离或 Z、无效像素规则必须逐版本核对。; 真值来源: 提供稠密网格、语义实例、平面及玻璃镜面信息；渲染位姿是仿真参考，不是物理跟踪测量。; 标定与时间: 轨迹和相机标定由渲染者设置；资产发布本身不包含物理 IMU 同步保证。; 评测协议: 注明序列生成者、场景清单、坐标约定和深度缩放；避免通过其他派生集训练到相同房间。

datasetDetails: en: Scenes and release scope: Blender Cycles renders two environments, Urban Canyon (a vehicle moving through a city) and Room/Indoor (a hovering or circularly moving camera in a confined room), each with three optics. The requested download page currently exposes these synthetic releases; real Flyroom and Zurich experiments in the paper are not assumed to be included.; Optics and representation: The paper reports nominal 90° perspective, 180° fisheye and 360° catadioptric configurations. The catadioptric view is an annular omnidirectional image with 360° azimuth, not a full-sphere 2:1 ERP panorama. The catadioptric camera faces upward toward its mirror; other synthetic camera orientations differ by scene.; Sampling and size: Official info archives list 2500 images/poses per Urban Canyon optic and 200 per Room optic, with image timestamps at approximately 30 Hz. Fisheye/catadioptric calibration files explicitly specify 640×480; the project holds sensor image resolution constant across optics. These are alternative rendered runs, not a synchronized physical multicamera or inertial rig.; Calibration: intrinsics.txt supplies a pinhole K matrix for perspective images and OCamCalib polynomial omnidirectional parameters for fisheye/catadioptric images. Backproject using that model and retain circular/annular validity masks; the supplied C++ model checks only rectangular image boundaries.; Pose format and association: groundtruth.txt stores image_id tx ty tz qx qy qz qw and T_world_camera, transforming camera coordinates into the world frame. Join image_id to images.txt for the timestamp in seconds; the first ground-truth column is a frame identifier, not a timestamp. These are simulator references, not estimated SLAM trajectories or motion capture.; Depth meaning and encoding: The optional .depth maps contain floating-point ASCII values separated by spaces, row-major and at image size. They store Euclidean distance along the optical ray, including the perspective release. With a unit bearing f, Z-depth = range × f_z; do not interpret the stored range as optical-axis Z.; Depth coverage check: The Room info archives enumerate 200 depth associations for each optic. Each Urban Canyon info archive lists only the first depth association despite 2500 image/pose entries. The larger depth archives are publicly reachable but were not fully downloaded in this audit; complete urban per-frame depth coverage must be checked in the chosen archive before evaluation.; Evaluation and splits: This is a controlled FoV/VO comparison with two scenes, not an official large-scale train/validation/test depth benchmark. No standard learning split is stated on the reviewed page or archive README. Avoid splitting corresponding optics of the same scene/trajectory across training and testing; use the appropriate camera orientation, model and valid pixel domain.; Access and provenance: Official image, depth, calibration/trajectory info and Blender-scene archives are linked without registration. Download endpoints responded successfully on 2026-10-19; only the six small info archives were downloaded. An IMU stream or hardware synchronization is not established by this synthetic release.; zh: 场景与收录范围: Blender Cycles 渲染两个环境：Urban Canyon 模拟车辆穿行城市，Room/Indoor 模拟狭小房间中悬停或绕圆运动的相机；每个环境有三种光学配置。用户提供的下载页当前展示这些合成数据，不据论文中的实验推定真实 Flyroom 和 Zurich 序列也在此发布。; 光学与图像表示: 论文给出标称 90° 透视、180° 鱼眼及 360° 折反射配置。折反射图像是覆盖 360° 方位角的环形全向像面，不是覆盖完整球面的 2∶1 ERP 全景。折反射相机朝上面向镜面；其他合成相机的朝向随场景而异。; 采样与规模: 官方 info 小包中，Urban Canyon 每种光学配置含 2500 条图像/位姿，Room 每种含 200 条；图像时间戳间隔约为 1/30 秒。鱼眼/折反射标定文件明确写 640×480，项目固定各配置的传感器图像分辨率。这些是不同光学配置的渲染序列，不是同步的真实多相机或惯性设备。; 标定: intrinsics.txt 对透视图像提供针孔 K 矩阵，对鱼眼/折反射图像提供 OCamCalib 多项式全向模型参数。按对应模型反投影并保留圆形/环形有效掩码；官方 C++ 实现的可见性检查仅判断矩形边界。; 位姿格式与关联: groundtruth.txt 格式为 image_id tx ty tz qx qy qz qw，变换为 T_world_camera，将相机坐标变到世界坐标。通过 image_id 与 images.txt 关联获取秒制时间戳；真值首列是帧 ID，不是时间戳。这些是仿真参考，不是 SLAM 估计轨迹或动作捕捉测量。; 深度语义与编码: 可选 .depth 文件以空格分隔的浮点 ASCII 编码，逐行存储，尺寸与图像相同。各配置（包括透视）存储的都是沿光学射线的欧氏距离 range。对单位视线 f，Z-depth = range × f_z；不能把文件内的距离直接当光轴 Z。; 深度覆盖核查: Room 的 info 包为每种配置列出 200 条深度关联；Urban Canyon 虽有 2500 条图像/位姿，但各 info 包的深度关联表仅列第一帧。本次确认大深度包可公开访问，未完整下载；正式评测前须在所选数据包中核查城市序列逐帧深度是否齐全。; 评测与划分: 这是两个场景的受控视场/VO 对比数据，不是官方大型深度学习训练基准。已核网页及包内 README 未规定统一训练/验证/测试划分。避免将同场景、同轨迹的不同光学配置拆到训练与测试两侧，并使用对应相机朝向、模型及有效像素域。; 获取与来源: 官方提供无需注册的图像、深度、标定/轨迹 info 及 Blender 场景包链接，2026-10-19 检查下载端点成功。本次仅下载六个小型 info 包；该合成发布未确立 IMU 数据流或硬件同步信息。

datasetNotes: en: The 360° catadioptric release is not classified as an ERP/full-sphere panoramic dataset in this atlas.; Depth and poses are generated by simulation; they do not measure real-scene sensor noise or generalization.; Photorealism was not the original release's main objective.; zh: 本图谱不将 360° 折反射环视数据归入 ERP/完整球面全景数据集筛选。; 深度与位姿来自仿真，不能表征真实传感器噪声或真实场景泛化。; 原始发布以几何条件下的 VO 对比为主，并非以完美照片真实感为目标。

datasetDetails: en: Projection and inputs: Kinect RGB/depth videos plus synchronized labeled RGB-D pairs in a MATLAB file; not fisheye or ERP.; Depth and validity: Both depths and aligned rawDepths are expressed in meters. depths fills missing values; rawDepths preserves holes before filling.; Ground truth: Structured-light sensor depth and semantic/instance labels. Inpainted pixels are processed supervision, not additional physical measurements.; Timing and calibration: Raw RGB and depth streams are unsynchronized with varying 20–30 FPS; timestamps and toolbox synchronization/calibration functions are supplied.; Evaluation: Disclose labeled/raw training subset, official split file, crop, depth cap and mask. Avoid using held-out scene raw frames for training.; zh: 投影与输入: Kinect RGB、深度视频及 MATLAB 文件中的同步标注 RGB-D 图像对，不是鱼眼或 ERP。; 深度与有效性: depths 与对齐后的 rawDepths 均以米表示；depths 填补缺失值，rawDepths 保留补全前空洞。; 真值来源: 结构光传感器深度与语义实例标注；补全像素属于处理后监督，不是新增物理测量。; 时间与标定: 原始 RGB、深度不同步，帧率在 20–30 FPS 间变化；提供时间戳、同步及标定工具。; 评测协议: 说明标注、原始训练子集、划分文件、裁剪、深度上限和掩码；不能用留出场景的原始帧训练。

datasetDetails: en: Inputs: 640×480 RGB and measured depth, nominally 30 Hz; timestamps are provided separately.; Depth convention: 16-bit PNG values divided by 5000 give metres; zero indicates missing depth. Released RGB/depth are registered.; Pose reference: Motion-capture trajectories at 100 Hz; pose format is timestamp tx ty tz qx qy qz qw in the reference world.; Calibration: Use the per-camera parameters and dataset notes; do not apply a second distortion correction to already registered depth.; Evaluation: Associate timestamps and apply the published ATE/RPE tools; retain depth holes and masks.; zh: 输入: 640×480 RGB 与实测深度，标称 30 Hz；各自提供时间戳。; 深度约定: 16 位 PNG 除以 5000 得到米，零值表示缺测；发布的 RGB/深度已经配准。; 位姿参考: 100 Hz 动作捕捉轨迹；格式为时间戳、平移 tx ty tz 和四元数 qx qy qz qw。; 标定: 使用各相机参数及数据说明；不要对已经配准的深度再次做畸变校正。; 评测: 先关联时间戳，再用官方 ATE/RPE 工具；保留深度空洞及有效掩码。
